title: Power Book IV: Force's Joseph Sikora Drops Another Hint On When Force Season Two's Debut Date To Be Released
htmlContent:
The anticipation was palpable as millions of fans eagerly awaited the return of one of Power's most beloved characters, Tommy Egan. His spin-off series, Power Book IV: Force, had left viewers on the edge of their seats as they watched him go head-to-head with the Flynns in Chicago. Fans had been waiting for news on when they could expect to see more of Tommy's story, and they finally got it when the TV star Joseph Sikora took to Twitter to share the exciting news.

Sikora's tweet sent Power fans into a frenzy, with many speculating on when they could expect to see the next season of Force. Some suggested that the show would return on May 27, but Sikora hinted that it would be later than that, though not as far off as next year.

Despite the disappointment of having to wait a little longer, fans were reassured by Sikora's promise that season two of Force would be excellent. His followers were quick to express their excitement, with many eagerly anticipating the chance to see Tommy return to their screens.

Some fans even speculated about the possibility of a crossover between Tommy and Tariq, another popular Power character. Sikora seemed to hint that he was open to the idea, sending fans into even more of a frenzy.

On Saturday, Forces' Joesph Sikora tweeted, "Season 2 announcement in less than 10 days."

Back in January, Sikora shared that the Starz didn't release the official date of season two of Power Book IV: Force, but had it on good authority that probably dropping in May of 2023.
